sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 380)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio and Armed Forces broadcasting, Nick & Nora Charles solving a ghostly haunting on *The Adventures of the Thin Man* for Maxwell House (1947), Henry Aldrich's summer lawn mowing scheme on *The Aldrich Family* for Postum (1940), Father Brown unraveling a locked garden murder on *Murder Clinic* (1943), Betty Winkler as *Joyce Jordan, M.D.* for Dreft (1947), *Jubilee* swing with Bobby Sherwood (1947), and Frank Lovejoy on *Calling All Detectives* (1940–1949):
